main_text.p:
Tota tibi ponatur anas, sed pectore tantum
Et ceruice sapit, cætera redde coquo.
main_text.head: Anserum & anatum in medicina vsus varius.
main_text.p: AAdeps.deps anserinus celebratissimi vsus est : cum melle morsui canis rabidi occurrit : medeturque vulneribus cum foliis cucurbitæ syluestris tritis. Sonitum auriumque grauitatem emendat cum succo cepatum. Cum pipere albo & similibus vtiliter illinitur ad perfrictiones, conuulsiones, cæcos ac subitos dolores, omniaque quæ acopis curantur. In leniendis verò & sedandis doloribus, ob partium scilicet & substantiæ tenuitatem magis penetrabilis adeps anserinus cæte-

page.notes: The top passage is set in italic and is a verse quotation from Martial, printed as prose lines; long s rendered as f in the italic type was read as s. "ganea" is doubtful in the scan. The verse lines are roman and indented. The head "Anserum & anatum in medicina / vsus varius." is a centred title. The marginal note "Adeps." stands in the right margin. The large initial "A" of "Adeps" is joined to the word. Some words in the lower paragraph are slightly faint but were read.
